decision.topology: existing static frontend plus independent mkt53_backend Docker Compose project on the current host
decision.apiIngress: same-origin /api/v1/ through shared nginx over dedicated mkt53_edge network
decision.database: PostgreSQL on internal-only mkt53_data network with no host or public port
decision.schemaMigration: explicit Alembic one-shot task; never automatic on API startup
decision.identityPrecondition: portal subject and role must be verifiable; nginx strips client identity headers and injects trusted values
decision.frontendMigration: static -> shadow -> api; static remains canonical until BE-06
decision.backup: daily logical backup, encrypted off-host copy, quarterly isolated restore drill
decision.budgetMeaning: internal decision threshold, not a cloud vendor quote
exitOrder: move PostgreSQL to a managed or independent database
move API to independent compute while preserving the same-origin API contract

nextGate.scope: local FastAPI and Compose skeleton, internal health, fail-closed configuration, portal identity and RBAC fixtures
